##### Project general facts

Enso Jade is a residential tower by Enso Development that combines contemporary architecture with an eco-friendly approach to living. The building offers 1-bedroom apartments with 1.5 bathrooms, 1-bedroom apartments with a study and 2 bathrooms, 2-bedroom apartments with a maid's room and 3 bathrooms, and 3-bedroom apartments with a maid's room and 4 bathrooms. The layouts are planned to use space efficiently, with large balconies and plenty of natural light in every home.

Residents have access to indoor and outdoor gyms and a Zen garden designed for relaxation. The building also provides dedicated bike parking and ample resident parking, supporting a convenient and balanced everyday lifestyle.

The apartments feature modern finishes with premium wood details and high-pressure melamine laminate flooring. The kitchens come fully equipped with matte-finished cabinetry, Italian artificial marble countertops and Siemens exhaust hoods. Bathrooms are fitted with Grohe and Duravit sanitaryware, and the residences include Carrier air conditioning, energy-efficient LED lighting and provision for home automation. The apartments are delivered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

The project is located in Jumeirah Garden City, a central residential area surrounded by greenery and urban amenities. Schools, shopping centres and recreational facilities are within easy reach, making the area suitable for both families and professionals.

Major highways nearby provide quick connections to Dubai's key business districts. Dubai International Financial Centre, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, City Walk and Coca-Cola Arena are all less than 10 minutes away.

The area also offers convenient access to cultural and leisure destinations, including La Mer Beach, the Museum of the Future and the Dubai Frame. This combination of a central address and well-developed surroundings makes the location attractive for living and investment.
